strongest_angle: Colorado Attorney General Phil Weiser issued an official advisory on October 6, 2026, reminding landlords of their legal obligations under House Bill 25-1168 to provide expanded housing protections and prevent illegal evictions for victim-survivors of domestic violence.

key_facts.fact: On October 6, 2026, Colorado Attorney General Phil Weiser issued a public advisory reminding Colorado landlords of expanded housing protections for victim-survivors of domestic violence under House Bill 25-1168.
The Colorado Attorney General’s Office issued the public advisory because it received reports of landlords not following their legal obligations under HB 25-1168.
House Bill 25-1168 prime sponsors include Representative Mandy Lindsay, Representative Cecelia Espenoza, and Senator Mike Weissman according to the Division of Real Estate summary.
Colorado Courts Daily reported that Attorney General Phil Weiser reminded Colorado landlords about new legal obligations toward survivors of domestic violence under House Bill 25-1168.
